document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You open fire on the depraved celebrants. As they rout into 
the bush, you relish the sight of those who writhe wounded 
on  the  mossy  ground.  “Professor!”  Sylvia  tugs  at  your  sleeve. 
“They’re coming around behind us!” You shove her hand away and 
empty your magazine toward the sounds approaching through 
the thickets. Suddenly, you notice that your companions have 
fled. Not wanting to become separated, you dart after them, but 
chattering noises in your path force you to veer down a ravine.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 284; if the result is odd, go to 116.
